standard: shampoo-classification-v1.6.1 candidate (lane-a scrubbed copy); not a locked policy id

formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2: 'Aqua/Water/Eau' one entry; colour entries one each; 35 normalized entries; normalized positions
formulaBlock.e3Point: Parfum/Fragrance @33; prominent = positions 1-32 (the declared allergens @27-31 precede Parfum in this list)

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no strong anionic; earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate @2 with prominent amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3; further mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @4, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @5. Counter-signal: three mild anionic routes.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high by the Section 5 high anchor (multiple complementary systems): prominent amino-silicone copolymer @12, two cationic polymers (Ethyltrimonium Chloride Methacrylate/Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein Copolymer @9, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @18), cationic conditioner Quaternium-95 @16, three protein routes (@9, @11, @13), payload lipid Sunflower Seed Oil @8, humectants Glycerin @6, Panthenol @7. C2 itself is not cleanly met (no pearlizing wax or fatty alcohol; a plant oil is read as the payload lipid, not as the pearlizing/fatty element). Counter-signal: everything after Panthenol @7 is plausibly sub-1 %; neighbor moderate.

cationic_polymer: Ethyltrimonium Chloride Methacrylate/Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein Copolymer @9
reset: mild anionic Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate @2, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @4, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @5

skipped: w_line_skipped:Panthenol@7 (ii) alkanolamide-type thickener PPG-2 Hydroxyethyl Cocamide@17 listed after it before the cap
wLineRecord.note: No a-c candidate between @8 and @20 besides Panthenol @7. Potassium Sorbate @21: (i) surfactants before; (ii) nothing of the structurant classes between @22 and @32. Sunflower Seed Oil @8 is material.

weightPotential.counterevidence: All deposition after Panthenol @7 (typically about 1 % or less) is plausibly small; the material status of the oil @8 depends on the alkanolamide skip of Panthenol.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W-RICH holds: material Sunflower Seed Oil @8 converging with a persistent amino-silicone copolymer @12 and cationic polymers @9/@18 (plus Quaternium-95 @16); reset is limited (C6 low, resetCapacity weak). The convergence route (silicone, two cationic polymers, cationic conditioner, protein film, material lipid) also holds.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would need reset to offset five converging families; a mild C6 chassis does not. The case for moderate rests only on unknown small amounts.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: amounts in the probable sub-1 % zone; W-line one skip away from excluding the oil
weightPotential.rationale: high: W-RICH with limited reset and multiple converging persistent families (6.6, 6.7); moderate confidence, neighbor moderate.

repairRoutes: Ethyltrimonium Chloride Methacrylate/Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein Copolymer @9
careDirection.limitation: formula-only; the repair cluster (three protein routes + amino-silicone) is somewhat stronger than the moisture cluster

focusPrimary.counterSignal: routes after Panthenol @7 are plausibly small amounts
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; formula dual_supported (repair-leaning); provisional general until a claim selects or tie-breaks (F1).

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: provisional regular; frequent possible with U2 wording (cleansing low); no dandruff active.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: provisional not_targeted (no positioning visible). CSA met: prominent comfort route Panthenol @7; humectant/refatting routes Glycerin @6, Panthenol @7, Sunflower Seed Oil @8; mild C6 chassis supportive.

dandruffSupport.rationale: not_supported: complete formula with no Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole or Selenium Sulfide/Disulfide.

surfactantClasses.c4: no defining anionic; C6 earliest prominent = Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate @2 with amphoteric @3

scalpExposure: Benzyl Alcohol @27, Linalool @28, Hexyl Cinnamal @29, Benzyl Salicylate @30, Citronellol @31

uncertainties: C2 'pearlizing/fatty route': no pearlizing wax or fatty alcohol; I did not let the sunflower oil fill both the lipid and the fatty element. conditioningLevel high is reached by the high anchor's multiple complementary systems instead; alternative moderate (neighbor).
weightPotential high vs moderate as in VT03-type formulas: formally W-RICH plus weak reset; amounts plausibly small; moderate confidence.
